headline_html:
1.3.0 — Node sync, stats, compact

Core, PyPI, and npm logosdb at 1.3.0. Node catches up with Python for durability and observability: db.sync() flushes WAL, index, vectors, and metadata; db.stats() returns the same counters as DB.stats(); compact(src, dst) copies live rows into a fresh directory and drops tombstones (#138). C API unchanged.
